Because the tide salt is published after the gale checkpoint, the cedar audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 97 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
